caption: The drawing depicts a single piece of furniture, specifically a wooden cabinet or chest, set against a light beige background. The cabinet is rendered in brown tones with visible grain and texture suggesting wood. It features an upper compartment with a large rectangular door, two drawers below, and another smaller upper drawer, each decorated with symmetrical patterns of light linear inlays and small dark circular accents, possibly representing knobs or decorative studs. The cabinet stands on four large, rounded bun feet. The upper portion has an overhanging, corniced top with molding details. The overall composition centers the cabinet, showing it from a frontal perspective with slight visibility of the cabinet’s side depth. The background is unornamented and plain, emphasizing the details of the cabinet itself.
